text_block_list.text:
Матиканэфукукитару wants to stop by
somewhere
before going home one day,
so I go with her...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Without further ado, let's bungee jump!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару
choice_data_list: I think there is much ado needed here!

text_block_list.text:
Well, let me explain first! In today's pair
fortune,
it said that bungee jumping
together would bring
us good luck!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: And that's not all! Look at the slogan!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
"Push yourself to the extremes! A
bungee
experience so divine that you'll
pierce the
heavens!" In other words, this
will take us to the
realm of the gods!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Urk... that jump was insane. I felt my soul
leave
my body...
text_block_list.name: Customer

text_block_list.text: Eek?! Their soul left their body?!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
W-we can't! My divinations are a
covenant
between me and Shiraoki! I
need to see this
through, no matter
what!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
And I've prepared an extra special lucky
charm
for the occasion!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I call it... the "survive with one HP"
charm!
Whatever comes my way, I should
be able to just
barely endure it!
Protection guaranteed!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
This is usually reserved for video games,
but I
thought it'd be perfect for regular
life-or-death
situations too.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
As long as I have this, my soul should
remain
firmly inside my body, a hundred
percent! Hm,
make that seventy. Maybe
less. Anyway, I'm sure
I'll be fine!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
C-come on! Let's give it a go and prove
what a
powerful pair we are!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару
choice_data_list: Okay, let's give it our best shot!
Let me go instead, for the both of us.

text_block_list.text:
C-come on! Let's give it a go and prove
what a
powerful pair we are!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару
choice_data_list: Okay, let's give it our best shot!
Let me go instead, for the both of us.

text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit! This'll be a breeze! A
breezy
jump, that is!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
We stand in line, waiting for our
numbers to be
called. At long last...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Eek, why are we this high?! At this rate,
we won't
pierce the heavens—the gods
will just open the
door for us!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah! I must steel my spirit... Glory be
to the
spinach leaf! Glory be to the
spinach leaf!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: Gyaaaaah!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Oof... I felt like I was going to spew
something,
and it wasn't going to be
words of wisdom, that's
for sure...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: Urk... Thank you... for... coming with me...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Without you here, I think I would have
let my soul
leave my body out of
despair...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Perhaps this experience was the hidden
meaning
to my divination. An
opportunity to form a strong
bond with
you.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text: Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Now then! I understand this may be
sudden, but
the time has come for us to
put that bond to the
test!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I'm clinging to life with just one HP to
my name,
so prove our bond by looking
after me!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Give me a piggyback ride! Oh, or we
could just
taxi it up. I really don't mind
either way!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Huh?! S-say it isn't so... You're proving
our
friendship by putting yourself on the
line?
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
That's unacceptable! Sacrificing yourself
like that
is not the way to go!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару
choice_data_list: I couldn't bear to sacrifice you.

text_block_list.text: You're willing to go that far for me?
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Our hearts truly beat as one... The great
Shiraoki
is sure to understand our
decision!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I will be with you in spirit, but it
won't
hurt to take this lucky charm with
you as well.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I made it by hand, so it's guaranteed to
bring
good fortune!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I line up to do the bungee jump on

Matikanefukukitaru's behalf.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Okay, get ready! Time to take the
bungee plunge!
text_block_list.name: Staff

text_block_list.text: ...ease... eЭпизод.. out... her...
Please, keep looking out for her.

Thank the gods! You're back! Are you
okay?
Soul's still in there, right?
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
For a brief moment, I felt like I was in a
strange
place and heard a voice
speaking to me... but it
looks like I
managed to get through the bungee

jump just fine.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Phew, that's good to hear. I was worried
sick
waiting for you.
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah! Living off of one HP must be
rough, but
I bought a load of stuff while
I was waiting!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I got you some nutrient-rich carrot juice
and a
taiyaki that's steaming real
auspiciously...
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I also had a go on the claw mach—I
mean, I tested
my luck and was blessed
with this friendship
bracelet! Try it on!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
I've looked up the bus times for us, so
just relax
and enjoy!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
No, I'm the one who should be thanking
you!
text_block_list.name: Матиканэфукукитару

text_block_list.text:
If it's our bond we're putting to the test,
shouldn't
we overcome this trial
together? We end up
walking home on
foot instead.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Матиканэфукукитару may be
unpredictable and a
little wild in her
ways, but her care is heartfelt and

genuine.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
